# SplitRE

> Commission management software for independent US real estate brokerages.

SplitRE is a web application that automates commission calculations, annual cap tracking, and bookkeeper-ready exports for real estate brokerages. It is built and operated by Keplify LLC, a Delaware-incorporated company.

## What SplitRE does

- Calculates agent commission splits from rule-based commission plans (percentage splits, tiered splits, flat post-cap fees, E&O and transaction fee deductions, referral deductions)
- Tracks each agent's annual gross commission income (GCI) toward their cap in real time
- Automatically flips agent splits to 100% (or a flat post-cap fee) when they cross their annual cap
- Splits one deal between up to six co-agents (co-listings, mentor deals, in-house buyer-and-listing transactions), each with a GCI share that runs through their own plan and their own cap
- Runs a team of agents on one shared annual cap, with an optional team lead who earns a set percentage of each member's commission on team deals
- Exports confirmed deals as a QuickBooks-ready CSV, with pre-formatted invoice and bill descriptions, for import into QuickBooks Online (one row per agent on a co-agent deal)
- Lets a broker email a confirmed deal's commission breakdown to the agent, download it as a PDF, or copy a share link to it, each with a single click
- Allows per-agent commission plan overrides without affecting brokerage-wide plans
- Supports mid-year cap migration for agents who join during a cap year

## Who it is for

Independent US real estate brokerages, typically 1 to 50 agents. Suitable for boutique broker-owners replacing spreadsheets, growing independents who need a QuickBooks-ready back office, and established brokerages with multiple commission plan structures.

## Pricing

Three plans, all features included on every tier, differentiated only by active agent headcount:

- Boutique: $35/mo or $348/yr, up to 10 agents
- Independent: $75/mo or $780/yr, up to 30 agents
- Brokerage: $199/mo or $2,028/yr, unlimited agents

All plans include a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.
